* Config file
*brave-flags.conf*
This file is specific to Arch Linux and should be placed under $HOME/.config/ or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME
* Violentmonkey
** System Fonts - Fast_Serif (Fully Embedded Base64)
#+begin_src js
// ==UserScript==
// @name         System Fonts - Fast_Serif (Fully Embedded Base64)
// @include      http*
// @locale       en
// @version      0.24
// @description  Fast_Serif everywhere – 100% self-contained, no downloads, no external files
// @author       P4Steve
// @grant        none
// @namespace    https://github.com/P4Steve
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
    'use strict';
    var s = document.createElement("style");
    s.type = "text/css";
    s.textContent = `
        @font-face {
            font-family: "Fast_Serif";
            src: url("data:font/ttf;base64,") format("truetype");
            font-display: swap;
        }
        * {
            font-family: "Fast_Serif", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif !important;
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
})();
#+end_src
** System Fonts - Fast_Sans (Fully Embedded Base64)
#+begin_src js
// ==UserScript==
// @name         System Fonts - Fast_Sans (Fully Embedded Base64)
// @include      http*
// @locale       en
// @version      0.24
// @description  Fast_Serif everywhere – 100% self-contained, no downloads, no external files
// @author       P4Steve
// @grant        none
// @namespace    https://github.com/P4Steve
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
    'use strict';
    var s = document.createElement("style");
    s.type = "text/css";
    s.textContent = `
        @font-face {
            font-family: "Fast_Sans";
            src: url("data:font;base64,");
            font-display: swap;
        }

        p, li, blockquote, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, dd, dt, a, span:not([class*="icon" i]):not([class*="symbol" i]) {
            font-family: "Fast_Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif !important;
            font-weight: 400 !important;
            font-feature-settings: "calt" 1, "liga" 1 !important;
            font-variant-ligatures: contextual !important;
            letter-spacing: normal !important;
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(s);

    // set "ALT + J" keyboard shortcut listener
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        // check if ALT is held down and the 'j' key is pressed
        if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'j') {
            // instantly toggle the disabled state of our style tag
            s.disabled = !s.disabled;
        }
    });
})();
#+end_src
